arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && for f in tie_stream drop_stream tie_burst big_stream; do python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < $f.json > $f.out; done && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json
o=json.load(open("tie_burst.out"))
tot_tie=sum(d["tie_overtakes"] for d in o["departures"])
tot_cmp=sum(d["comparable"] for d in o["departures"])
print("tie_burst: departures", len(o["departures"]), "ticks", o["ticks"], "idle", o["idle"],
      "tie_sum", tot_tie, "cmp_sum", tot_cmp, "rank_err_sum", sum(d["rank_error"] for d in o["departures"]))
for rg in o["ranges"]:
    if sum(rg["counts"]): print("  nonempty range counts", rg["counts"], "bound", rg["bound"], "observed", rg["observed"])
    else: assert rg["bound"]==0 and rg["observed"]==0
assert o["ticks"]-o["idle"]==120000

for name in ("big_stream","tie_stream","drop_stream"):
    s=json.load(open(name+".out")); f=s["final"]
    res=sum(len(q) for q in f["queues"])
    print(name, "events", len(s["events"]), "attempted", f["totals"]["attempted"],
          "accepted", f["totals"]["accepted"], "departed", f["totals"]["departed"],
          "residents", res, "dropped", f["totals"]["dropped"], "idle", f["totals"]["idle"],
          "updates", sum(1 for ev in s["events"] if ev["update"]))
    assert f["totals"]["accepted"]==f["totals"]["departed"]+res
    assert f["totals"]["attempted"]==f["totals"]["accepted"]+f["totals"]["dropped"]
    last=s["events"][-1]["sizes"]
    assert last==[len(q) for q in f["queues"]]
    acc=dep=0
    for ev in s["events"]:
        acc+=sum(1 for a in ev["arrivals"] if a["accepted"])
        if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"]: dep+=1
        assert sum(ev["sizes"])==acc-dep, (name, ev["t"])
    # totals cross-check
    t=f["totals"]
    assert t["departed"]==dep and t["accepted"]==acc
    assert t["inversions"]==sum(ev["service"]["packet"]["rank_error"] for ev in s["events"] if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"])
    assert t["comparable"]==sum(ev["service"]["packet"]["comparable"] for ev in s["events"] if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"])
    assert t["tie_overtakes"]==sum(ev["service"]["packet"]["tie_overtakes"] for ev in s["events"] if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"])
    assert t["wait_sum"]==sum(ev["service"]["packet"]["wait"] for ev in s["events"] if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"])
    assert t["idle"]==sum(1 for ev in s["events"] if ev["service"] and ev["service"]["packet"] is None)
    print("   accounting OK; inversions", t["inversions"], "comparable", t["comparable"],
          "tie", t["tie_overtakes"], "wait_sum", t["wait_sum"], "wait_max", t["wait_max"])
EOF
